author: William Shakespeare
selection: First complete scene in Act I; use its earliest contiguous prefix not exceeding 120 estimated seconds, ending at a complete speaker-turn or stage-direction boundary. Do not choose based on model output.
adaptation: Preserve dialogue words and order; normalize whitespace; separate source stage directions; attach Unspecified emotion, never inferred emotion. Speech duration assumes 150 words/minute; stage directions assume 2 seconds. These are synthetic timing coordinates, not measured footage.
first_attempt_policy: One registered uncached AI extraction; retain abstention, unavailable audits and failure. No retuning against the result and no switching excerpts to obtain a pass.
independence_scope: Independent authorship and external to this project development corpus. Public classic may be present in model pretraining; not a novel privately supplied contemporary microdrama or authenticated independent evaluator input.
